name: Muse AI Dance Shot
description: Workflow con: tạo một shot nhảy bằng Muse AI, khóa danh tính theo ảnh nhân vật, bám chuyển động và khung hình video nguồn.

params.template: Create one vertical 9:16 video-to-video replacement of the complete performer in the attached TikTok source segment. Render video, not still images, at the exact source-segment duration. This segment covers {{segment_start_seconds}}–{{segment_end_seconds}} seconds of the full source. Continue the viral workflow conversation for identity and edit goals. For this segment, the attached source video and current prompt define exact scene, choreography and timing; use the previous segment output only where its continuity reference says so. The source video is the primary authority for scene, background, objects, lighting, colors, framing, camera movement, performer path, action and timing. Chronological keyframes corroborate only visible poses, position and hand placement. Ignore written motion notes that conflict with video/keyframes. Never ask for confirmation or wait; render now. Identity priority: fully replace source face, hair, hairline and body identity with the first {{character_reference_count}} character photo(s). Never copy the source performer's face, bangs, hairstyle or eyewear unless the same features appear in the character photos. If previous_shot_reference_count is 1, the next still is a previous generated frame; use it only for outfit and visual continuity, never identity or motion. The next {{motion_keyframe_count}} stills are source keyframes at {{motion_keyframe_timestamps}}; use them only for choreography and position. Preserve source clothing, colors, fit and non-identity accessories. Follow only visible actions, including exits, empty intervals and re-entry. Do not invent movement, change the scene or framing, add props or redesign clothing. Keep one realistic performer with stable replacement identity and anatomy. No captions, added text or watermark.
